verdict.rationale: The evidence pack documents no AI assistant built into Stripe itself, such as one in the Dashboard, that users can delegate tasks to. The MCP server, agent plugins, skills, and AI-analytics features all serve external agents (Claude Code, Codex, Cursor) acting on Stripe from outside. Those are developer building blocks and a different product role, so they earn no credit here. Radar's AI fraud scoring and the Workbench Shell are adjacent features, not a delegatable assistant.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can delegate tasks to a built-in AI assistant inside the product
